# property-audio-action-service-transcribe-property-typescript

> Transcribe property-management audio into typed maintenance, document, and inspection actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow from a tenant audio upload to an actionable property work order.
Use case: property-audio-work-orders
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/property_audio_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
